name: read-katona-jarai

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import re
s=open('sources/2409.10129.txt').read()
print('KATONA RANGE 9000-12500'); print(s[9000:12500])
t=open('sources/1507.04169.txt').read()
for m in re.finditer(r'Conjecture|a_\*|maximiz',t): print(m.start(),t[max(0,m.start()-60):m.start()+120].replace('\n',' '))
i=t.find('Conjecture')
print('JARAI RANGE',i-3500,i+2500); print(t[max(0,i-3500):i+2500])
